itens.trecho: Onde estão os Óscares para este filme incrível? Este filme aborda um assunto raramente visto no cinema: a forma como as acções individuais podem, ao longo do tempo, influenciar o curso de eventos futuros. Ele mistura seis histórias diferentes no passado, presente e futuro. É dirigido por Tom Tykwer, que também escreveu o roteiro com Lana e Lilly Wachowski.

The true legacy of the Wachowskis, so close to pulling off the impossible that it is not wholly understandable in one viewing. The central theme is the idea of karma. Actions affecting our lives, not just in this life but through several incarnations.

Cloud Atlas was a very well made movie but unlike a lot of movies that try to tell simultaneous stories and then have them come together at the end, this one just didn't for me. I'm still unclear as to the point of it all. Another issue I had was a general feeling of goofiness.
